steps.text: Gummy is the second one in her dorm to wake up every morning. And she has a habit.
As soon as Istina wakes her, they share a handshake. Gummy then goes next door to wake Zima in the same fashion.
Whether 'The General' decides to shake her hand or not depends entirely on her mood.
Rhodes Island Dormitories - Istina and Gummy's Room

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (But she sure is taking her time today. Maybe she's been working too hard?)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (But I'm gonna be late if I keep waiting for her. C'mon, Gummy, just get up already!)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: What happened to my night light?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Weird... Did she head out already?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I guess she had something important to do.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: 'Gummy, we went out. Won't be back until evening. Please look after yourself.'

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hmph! Look at them treating me like a kid again. Of course I can take care of myself!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: That means Zima's already up too.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oops, I better hurry up and report in or I'm gonna be late.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Just gotta grab my trusty shield and frying pan...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I left in a hurry this morning and didn't have time to fill up my tummy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But I guess I should focus on work first and grab some food afterwards.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Order up! Ready for the counter!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Gotta do a shchi next? Okay, I'll have it right out!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Food's ready! Please take it to the dining area!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Next up is... Mhm, we got another fried pelmeni.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Just need someone to take this order, then I crank out the pelmeni and I'm good to go.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Gummy, I have my hands full over here! Put that out for me?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I got this. It's way lighter than my shield.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Why is everyone in such a hurry today? I turn my head for a second and she's gone...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh well, guess I'll just ask where to put it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's gotta go around here somewhere. The lady at the cash register, that's... Gitano, right?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Why are you out here with your frying pan? Do you need my help?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Just one thing. Could you tell me where to put the shchi? It's getting cold!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Shchi, huh? If I recall correctly, it goes there in the middle, where Courier is standing.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Are you sure you don't need any help, Little Cub?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm perfectly fine! See you later, Gitano!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Forget it. You couldn't lift it anyway.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Welcome, what can I get for you?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Braised pork and vegetables? Coming right up. And a steamed egg with your stir-fried vegetables? No problem.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Sorry to bother you, Gummy, but would you mind taking this pot back to the kitchen?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: You've really outdone yourself, Gummy. C'mere, I have a cookie for you. You must be hungry, right?

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: It's my pleasure. Make sure to have a proper meal after this, all right?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: See you later, Gitano. I need to head back and get some stuff done.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (Just hold out a bit longer... It's almost time to eat!)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Wooaahh! Kay, you can't go in there!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You can't! Don't you see the sign on the door?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I see a red circle with a tilty red line going through it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: That means 'Kay is not allowed in here.' Got it?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If you get it, why are you still going in?!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If you're hungry, you can just get in line and order something to eat.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Y- You're not allowed in there!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Fine, fine! I'll think of something!!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If I give you this cookie, will you promise not to go inside?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: There's... there's still... one more to go...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Just hold on... just a little longer!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I can't even scoop up the food......

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I can't do this anymore. I have to eat something!
Gummy has a habit. When she's famished, something takes hold of her,
And she can't resist her urge to eat...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: So soft... Mmmhh.... It must be delicious.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Gummy, why are you chewing on my hip?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (Gummy is practically inhaling the bread in her hands...)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (...washing it down with a swig of soup.)

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: C-calm down, Gummy, the food's not going anywhere. And we got training in the afternoon, y'know.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (She doesn't leave a single scrap on her plate...)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (...and doesn't hesitate to reach for seconds.)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (In no time, she's gobbled up an entire table full of food.)

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'll get back to you later.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Whew. I feel like a whole new Gummy!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Instructor, don't you want to eat?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Sure do. But somehow all the food I brought out disappeared into your belly.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Don't worry about it, I can always get more.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: By the way, how'd you end up so hungry? You skip breakfast or something?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I overslept this morning and didn't have time to eat, so...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Y'know, you might just be that type of girl. With a bottomless pit for a stomach.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yup, just like that one over there.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Kay? She's charging the kitchen again?! I better—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Relax, we got someone keeping an eye on her. Plus, they laid out some goodies near the door just in case she gets in. She won't make it to anything important.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, I thought those were welcome baskets for new recruits...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Yeah that too. Whatever gets the job done.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If we sealed that door, it'd hurt her feelings. Letting her in every now and then lets her feel like she won. And it doesn't cost us much.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Um, so who's in charge of keeping an eye on her?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Good choice. She's always got it together.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: That reminds me, I have to ask you something. It has to do with training.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I notice you have trouble moving your arms, especially in quick, repetitive motions. Why is that?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I've watched you in combat, and it's the same in the kitchen. You get two good strokes in and then you have to stop.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Huh—? Well, that's a bad habit if I ever saw one. Can we fix it?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Because stopping like that on the battlefield is gonna get you killed.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: But if we can cure you, I'm sure you've got the next Rhodes Island Chopping Competition in the bag.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Good. We'll get to it after defender practice.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We won't know if we can fix that habit until we try.
Rhode Island Training Center - Defender Training Room

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Last round of the day. Let's power through.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I want four sets of planks, time—

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Okay, we're done. Go cool off.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You ready? What we talked about at lunch?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'll get the training shield, and you can use your weapon there.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Now relax. That's gonna be an important part of your rehab.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Okay, Gummy. I want you to hit me as hard as you can.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I know you're tired from afternoon training, but it's actually the perfect time to work on this.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Great. Now gimme whatever's left in the tank.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (If it's a conditioned reflex, that should have shaken out some more swings.)
Gummy is a good cook, but she has a habit.
She chops only twice. Should she ever chop a third time——
She'll chop straight through the cutting board, right into the counter itself.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'm fine, I'm fine. It's just been a long time since I took a hit like that.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Is this another one of your 'habits'?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Relax. I told you, I'm fine.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: But it looks like this problem of yours is more complicated than I thought.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: On your third swing, you subconsciously put your full strength into it. Is that right?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: And I'm guessing that takes a fourth swing off the table.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If we were in the kitchen just now, you'd've chopped that cutting board into a nice, clean pair.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Here I thought we just had to push you over the edge... Turns out there's something else going on here.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I jumped headfirst into this without really feeling it out. Sorry, Gummy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's my fault for being a lousy student.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Let's call it for today. You go home and rest up. Give me some time to noodle on this.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: But if you want to try again, you know where to find me.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (Those Ursus Youth Scouts are stupid strong.)

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (I better pay Gavial a visit in Medical.)

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: (I'll grab her something to eat on the way.)
Rhodes Island Dormitories - Zima, Istina, and Gummy's Quarters
She does not turn on the lights.
She hangs her 'shield' in the corner,
She wants to do better, for everyone who does so much to help her.
Since coming to Rhodes Island, Gummy's 'habits' only bred more habits.
And she knows those habits bother the people around her.
She can do nothing but keep on being 'Gummy.'
She carries a safe door and a frying pan with her everywhere she goes.
She uses the entire tube of toothpaste, going so far as to suck out the last few drops.
When up somewhere high, she keeps far away from the edge, even if there's a guardrail.
When she's famished, she has to fight the urge to devour the nearest object. Should she fail...
If she finds herself in the dark too long...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Oh, Gummy, you're back? Why didn't you turn on the lights?
All her myriad habits dissipate as soon as she sees Zima and Istina.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No doubt she was sniveling alone in the corner after something shook her.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What am I gonna do with you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Gummy, start cleaning. Leto is coming.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: There. Give Istina back her handkerchief after you wash it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Get to work, Gummy. I did the shopping. The rest is up to you two.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Okay. What's so special about today anyway?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: It's been exactly one year since we came to Rhodes Island. Zima even woke up early for the occasion. If you believe it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Phew— I'm beat. I'm gonna lay down for a bit. Call me when Leto gets here.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh no you're not. There's too much to be done.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'll go prepare the refreshments. You're responsible for getting Zima up.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Spare me the schmaltz. I'm sleepy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Good. Now put her to work. I have my hands full.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Ugh. I just carried all those bags. Why do I have to work more?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Call it the burden of command.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Come on in and give me a hand.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What're you standing around for? Get busy.
It's a laugh from the very depths of her soul.
And she wants everyone to share such a laugh.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (It's been a long time since we all got together.)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (I hope Rosa can come next time.)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I ate your cookie earlier, so I got you a new one.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan taught me how to make it. It's fresh outta the oven.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hurry up and eat it before it gets cold.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Nichego sebe, that's one hell of a cookie.
Rhodes Island Dormitories - Zima, Istina, and Gummy's Quarters

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Phew. That was great. But now it's bedtime.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Just need my trusty night light...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Now that I think of it, it wasn't on this morning either.
She absolutely must sleep with a night light.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Can I sleep with you tonight?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Are you sleeping with us too?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Can the three of us really fit in Gummy's bed?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Guess we're making a Gummy bear sandwich.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: All right. Just tell me if it gets too hot and stuffy. I'll go back to my room.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'm turning out the lights. Good night.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: When was the last time we all slept together like this?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I can't even remember. I don't even want to remember.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Forget I asked. Just get some sleep.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: As soon as her head hits the pillow, huh?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Guess I'm the only one who doesn't pass right out.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Settle down, brain. We got a busy day tomorrow. Ugh.
You know the Ursus Student Self-government Group?
They're the habit Gummy just can't quit.
